nodes.prompt:
TASK: Dispatch exactly one retained ChatGPT Web helper batch containing the two implementation tasks below.
DELIVERABLE: Return the complete helper JSON result for every worker, including scope_id, browser binding, terminal state, completion_check, workspace_revision, and any authoritative error.
SCOPE: Read only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ORCA_LITE_FIX_PLAN.md and repository state to assemble the two supplied task objects. Do not edit repository files yourself. Invoke only /Users/indo/code/project/omo-bridge/target/debug/delegate_to_chatgpt_web once, with --batch-stdin --json; do not set --browser-driver. Do not create a second helper, close any scope, use --close-on-terminal, or bypass capacity/rate-limit controls.
VERIFY: The helper process exits 0, returns two distinct scope_id values, and each terminal worker reports ready=true in completion evidence. If it returns an authoritative terminal error, capacity exhaustion, or rate-limit cooldown, report that exact JSON without retrying.
STOP WHEN: Report the helper JSON result or its authoritative terminal error.

Use a JSON batch with two tasks, both workspace /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite:

label=orca-lite-backend-phase-3-8
TASK: Finish all remaining backend portions of ORCA_LITE_FIX_PLAN.md and create authorized verified commits.
DELIVERABLE: src-tauri-only source/test/config edits; one atomic writer-lease completion commit, then a separate remaining-backend safety/IPC/performance commit when independently green; exact commit hashes and test/clippy output.
SCOPE: Read the repository; write only src-tauri/**. Read but do not edit ui/**, ORCA_LITE_FIX_PLAN.md, .omo/**, or root package files. Preserve unrelated changes. First complete and prove the existing uncommitted writer-lease work in src-tauri/src/worktree/{manager,model,git}.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/worktree.rs, and src-tauri/tests/worktree_safety.rs, including terminal lifecycle integration. Then implement the remaining backend phases: registered workspace/worktree identity with canonical allowed-root and symlink/leading-dash defenses; terminal/worktree IPC that does not trust raw paths or execute raw shell strings; structured IPC errors; CSP in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json; worktree_changed events; camelCase serde DTOs; Git I/O isolated with spawn_blocking at async IPC boundaries. Keep default branch deletion safe and destructive deletion explicit. Add seam regression tests.
VERIFY: Demonstrate relevant added tests fail before implementation, then run cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml and cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings, both exit 0. Confirm git diff stays in allowed scope; report every edited path and commit hash.
STOP WHEN: Required backend commits and checks are green, or report the first concrete unresolvable failure with captured output.

label=orca-lite-frontend-phase-7-8
TASK: Finish all remaining frontend portions of ORCA_LITE_FIX_PLAN.md and create authorized verified commits.
DELIVERABLE: ui-only edits plus root PERF_NOTES.md; an atomic IPC-wrapper/camelCase/error-code commit and a separate lazy-load/lifecycle optimization commit when independently green; exact commit hashes and test/build evidence.
SCOPE: Read the repository; write only ui/** and PERF_NOTES.md. Read but do not edit src-tauri/**, ORCA_LITE_FIX_PLAN.md, .omo/**, or other root files. Preserve unrelated changes. Complete uncommitted App.tsx, deleted ui/src/types.ts, ui/src/lib/tauri.test.ts, and ui/src/lib/ipcErrors.test.ts. Enforce one typed Tauri wrapper surface, camelCase contract types, structured error-code branching, no component direct command strings. Then lazy-load xterm and WebGL assets without altering terminal ownership; preserve Canvas fallback/context-loss disposal; add observable WebGL lifecycle counters and measured evidence to PERF_NOTES.md. Add behavior-focused tests only.
VERIFY: Demonstrate relevant added tests fail before implementation, then run bun --cwd ui test and bun --cwd ui run build with exit 0. Report production chunks or warnings and lifecycle instrumentation evidence. Confirm git diff scope and commit hashes.
STOP WHEN: Required frontend commits and checks are green, or report the first concrete unresolvable failure with captured output.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Run the complete repository acceptance checks after the retained Web implementation batch reaches terminal state.
DELIVERABLE: PASS/FAIL with each literal command, exit code, relevant output, and git status --short.
SCOPE: Read only /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite and its test/build outputs. Do not edit files, create/close Web sessions, commit, or use destructive Git commands.
VERIFY: Execute exactly: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings; bun --cwd ui test; bun --cwd ui run build. PASS requires all four exit code 0. Inspect the production build output and state chunk-size warnings or their absence.
STOP WHEN: Report PASS with all captured exit-0 checks, or FAIL on the first command failure with its concrete output.
